meaning:
1) desire, longing, craving
1a) of man for woman
1b) of woman for man
1c) of beast to devour

renderings.kjv: And unto thee shall be his desire

elsewhere.note: To the woman he said, “I will greatly multiply your pain in childbirth. You will bear children in pain. Your desire will be for your husband, and he will rule…
I am my beloved’s. His desire is toward me.
